piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — Diagonal Continuation A.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — Diagonal Continuation A
piece.description: Reusable native diagonal DD RHW-4 continuation half with an authored concrete centre pier meeting both deck pavement planes. Use the complementary half and the assembly placement guide; traffic follows measured native car lanes.

provenance.geometry: Measured native DD RHW-4 and Avenue channels with authored compact ramps.
provenance.construction: Reviewed exclusive tile partition; four proper rotations repeated.
provenance.supports: One 0.8 m square open-sided concrete column at the native tile centre, from ground 0 m to upper pavement 15 m; six repeated placements in the complete assembly.
provenance.partition_review: Reviewed one-diagonal-tile ramp extension and right-turn-only access. Retains piece, puzzle, menu, preview, and reserved resource-block identities; local model slots follow the revised AutoTileBase grid. Native MIS materials replace the flat atlas.
